# Pipelines, and sharing a run

## In a pipeline

The suite carries pipeline files for GitHub (`.github/workflows/`), GitLab (`.gitlab-ci.yml`) and Azure
(`azure-pipelines.yml`): the quick check on every push and pull request, every test when started by hand. Nothing
runs on a timer unless you turn it on: each file's `YOURS (schedule)` block holds its nightly run, and the stories
job's hourly poll, commented out; take the `# ` off those lines to run them (the time is UTC), and a rebuild keeps
them as you leave them. Keep the pipeline you use and delete the others; a rebuild leaves them deleted. The
`Dockerfile` runs the suite anywhere.

## Sharing

- `java pack/Pack.java --run` zips the last run's failures, report and the read of the site, beside this folder, and says its
  size: to send to whoever helps.
- The test library (`node menu/library.mjs`) puts every test on one page, run with a click; "Put the test library
  on the desktop" in `crew` gives someone who never opens a terminal an icon to double-click.
- "Get the team's latest tests" in `crew` brings in what the team pushed to the suite's repository, never
  overwriting a change made on this computer.
